verdict.rationale: Telemetry is a fair question for a terminal emulator, but nothing in the pack documents a kitty setting or flag for opting out of telemetry, usage tracking or update checks. The kitty.conf items are bare titles with no content about such an option. The community post about maintainer responses to privacy concerns over update checks (PR #3544) does not document any opt-out capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
